FIELDS.DESCRIPTION OF OPERATIONS: TeleCom Connect Solutions specializes in providing high-quality cable and telecommunications services, including installation, repair, and maintenance of residential and commercial low-voltage wiring systems. Our operations focus on the deployment of reliable high-speed internet, cable television, and telephony solutions tailored to the needs of our clients. We manage a fleet of trained technicians who are well-versed in the latest industry standards and safety protocols, ensuring efficient and secure service delivery. Our commitment to customer satisfaction is reflected in our no-claims history over the past five years, showcasing our effective risk management practices. We do not engage in high-voltage infrastructure work, maintaining a clear focus on low-risk services.
FIELDS.OTHER BUSINESSES OWNED: TeleCom Media Group, LLC - A subsidiary focused on digital content delivery and streaming services, complementing our cable and telecommunications offerings.
FIELDS.DESCRIPTION OF LOSSES: Loss Date: 06/12/2022; Cause: Damage to cable lines due to weather conditions; Amount: $5,000; Status: Resolved
FIELDS.ADDRESS: 4567 Fiber Lane, Suite 100, Tech City, NY 12345-6789
FIELDS.HOURS OF OPERATION: Monday to Friday, 8:00 AM to 6:00 PM; Saturday, 9:00 AM to 4:00 PM; Closed on Sunday
FIELDS.SAFE/VAULT DETAILS: Class 5, Grade A, Secured with electronic locking system, monitored 24/7.
FIELDS.OTHER PROTECTION: Security fencing and on-site watchpersons to monitor premises during non-business hours.
FIELDS.G1: Do/have past, present or discontinue: No – TeleCom Connect Solutions does not engage in storing, treating, discharging, applying, disposing, or transporting hazardous materials as our operations focus on low-voltage wiring systems and do not involve such activities. Our commitment to safety and effective risk management is reflected in our no-claims history over the past five years.
FIELDS.G2: Are athletic teams sponsored?: No – TeleCom Connect Solutions does not sponsor athletic teams, as our focus is primarily on providing cable and telecommunications services without involvement in sporting events.
FIELDS.G3: Are sub-contractors allowed to work: No – Subcontractors are not allowed to work without providing a certificate of insurance. The company has designated personnel who are responsible for checking and verifying these certificates to ensure compliance and adequate risk transfer.
FIELDS.G4: Has any applicant been indicted or c: No – TeleCom Connect Solutions has not had any applicants indicted or convicted of fraud, bribery, arson, or any related crimes. Our operations maintain a strong commitment to ethical practices and compliance with legal standards.
FIELDS.G5: Any policy or coverage declined, can: No – TeleCom Connect Solutions has not experienced any policy or coverage declines, cancellations, or non-renewals during the prior three years. Our history demonstrates a commitment to effective risk management and compliance with insurance obligations.
FIELDS.G6: Do you lease employees to or from ot: No – TeleCom Connect Solutions does not lease employees to or from other employers; our workforce is entirely comprised of directly employed technicians and staff.
FIELDS.G7: Any Workers Compensation carried?: Yes – TeleCom Connect Solutions carries Workers' Compensation insurance to comply with legal requirements and ensure the safety and protection of our employees while they perform their duties.
FIELDS.G8: Do you own or operate any other busi: Yes – TeleCom Connect Solutions owns and operates a subsidiary, TeleCom Media Group, LLC, which focuses on digital content delivery and streaming services, complementing our core cable and telecommunications offerings.
FIELDS.G9: Any other insurance with this compan: No – TeleCom Connect Solutions does not have any other insurance policies with this company at this time. Our current policy is focused solely on our cable and telecommunications operations.
FIELDS.G10: Are you involved in manufacturing,: No – TeleCom Connect Solutions is not involved in manufacturing, mixing, relabeling, or repackaging of products. Our services are focused solely on installation, repair, and maintenance of low-voltage wiring systems for telecommunications.
FIELDS.G11: Do you rent or loan equipment to ot: No – TeleCom Connect Solutions does not rent or loan equipment to others, as our operations primarily focus on providing installation and maintenance services for telecommunications and cable systems. This approach ensures that we maintain full control over our equipment and service delivery.
FIELDS.G12: Has applicant had a foreclosure, re: No – TeleCom Connect Solutions has not had any foreclosure, repossession, bankruptcy, judgment, or lien during the past five years, maintaining a strong financial standing with no claims history.
FIELDS.G13: Any exposure to flammables, explosi: No – TeleCom Connect Solutions does not have any exposure to flammables, explosives, or chemicals, as our operations focus exclusively on low-voltage wiring systems and telecommunications services that minimize such risks.
FIELDS.G14: Any catastrophe exposure?: No – TeleCom Connect Solutions operates in low-risk telecommunications services and does not engage in activities that would expose the business to significant catastrophe risks.
FIELDS.G15: Any past losses or claims relating: No – TeleCom Connect Solutions has not had any past losses or claims relating to sexual abuse or molestation allegations, discrimination, or negligent hiring, demonstrating a strong commitment to ethical practices and compliance.
FIELDS.G16: Any uncorrected fire code violation: No – TeleCom Connect Solutions is in full compliance with fire codes and has no uncorrected fire code violations.
